summary: Knight-Swift Transportation Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K reporting results of its Annual Meeting of Stockholders held May 12, 2026, and the declaration of a quarterly cash dividend of $0.20 per share payable June 22, 2026 to holders of record June 8, 2026. Stockholders elected eleven directors, approved executive compensation on an advisory basis, ratified Grant Thornton LLP as auditor, and voted against a political spending transparency proposal. This is a routine annual meeting report and a regular dividend declaration; no special situation or extraordinary corporate event is disclosed.
